caption:
Comment SNORE for your free snoring check 💤

Snoring is the joke in every relationship, until you're the one lying awake at 2am.

The NHS says sleeping on your side, cutting out alcohol and keeping to a healthy weight can all help. If someone notices you stop breathing, gasp or choke in your sleep, see your GP, as it can be a sign of sleep apnoea.

Who's the snorer in your house? Be honest.

Save this for tonight, and send it to the person who keeps you awake.
